describe.description: The creature is shown in side view facing right against a plain off-white background. It has a low, elongated, quadrupedal body with a broad blunt head at the front and a long broad flattened tail at the rear. The dorsal surface from the back of the neck to the tip of the tail is covered with overlapping brown to gray-brown rounded scales arranged in diagonal rows, with a low pale mid-dorsal ridge visible along the back. The ventral surface, the head, the sides of the neck, and the four short limbs are pale pinkish-gray with wrinkled skin and, on the head, scattered darker mottling. Behind the head on both sides of the neck are multiple reddish-pink feathery stalks. The limbs are short and stout and end in small toed feet, and the tail is dorsally scaled and ventrally pale, tapering to a rounded tip.
